name: 🥟 Pierogi Party + Salad
tagline: Pierogies pan-fried golden with sweet buttery onions, plus a crisp salad on the side.

items.name: Dijon or honey for the dressing

steps.text: Melt 2 Tbsp butter in a big nonstick skillet over medium. Add the onions and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
Meanwhile, boil the pierogies 4 minutes (or follow the box), then drain well.
Push the onions to the side, add 2 Tbsp butter and the pierogies in one layer. Fry until golden on both sides.
Shake the dressing in a jar: oil, vinegar, Dijon or honey, salt, pepper.
Toss the spring mix, tomatoes and cucumber with dressing right before eating.
Pile the onions on the pierogies; serve with sour cream.

kid_jobs.job: Shake the dressing in a jar (lid on tight!)
Halve the cherry tomatoes with a kid knife
Spoon out sour cream for everyone

chef_tip: Take your time on the onions. Low and slow until they're golden and sweet turns a box of frozen pierogies into a real dinner.
make_ahead: Caramelize a big batch of onions ahead; they keep 4 days and are great on burgers too.
leftovers: Re-fry in a skillet; the microwave makes them gummy.
swaps: Add sliced kielbasa or bacon to the onions
serve_with: The salad (above), applesauce for the girls
heads_up: Onions go in first; they take the longest.
